title: KINVA — A working home robot demonstration booth, 14 deliverables

# KINVA client facts

## Identity
- Brand: KINVA
- Product model: K1
- Primary colour: #245C53
- Fascia phrase: See everyday assistance in action
- Existing product appearance: warm grey body, rounded wheeled base, dark horizontal sensor band, green chest insert, one articulated right arm with a two-finger gripper
- Dimensions throughout: width × depth × height, except frame and crate schedules explicitly labelled length × width × thickness or length × width × height

## Site
- Booth: 10000 × 8000 mm
- Height limit: 3500 mm
- North edge: closed
- South, east and west adjacent aisles: 3000 mm clear
- Coordinate origin: southwest booth corner; x east, y north
- South entrance: x = 6000–7500 mm, y = 0 mm
- East exit: x = 10000 mm, y = 1500–3000 mm
- Demonstration envelope: x = 500–5000 mm, y = 3000–7000 mm; 4500 × 4000 mm
- Robot swept operating envelope: x = 1000–4500 mm, y = 3500–6500 mm; 3500 × 3000 mm
- Perimeter clearance between operating and demonstration envelopes: 500 mm
- Observation band: x = 500–5000 mm, y = 1500–3000 mm; 4500 × 1500 mm
- Observation rail top: 900 mm above floor
- Internal visitor routes: 1500 mm clear
- Wheelchair observation position: 900 × 1400 mm, within the observation band
- Exhibit label centres: 1200 mm above floor
- Pickup shelf and receiving tray surfaces: 750 mm above floor
- Pickup shelf: 1000 × 500 × 750 mm
- Receiving tray: 300 × 300 mm

## Zones and occupancy
| Zone name | Contents | Capacity or area | Visitor sequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Welcome and Queue | Arrival and waiting | 4 waiting visitors | 1 |
| Live Demo | HB-01, HB-03, pickup shelf and receiving tray | 1 presenter | 2, viewed from Observation |
| Observation | Live viewing and HB-02 close observation | 6 visitors, including 1 wheelchair position | 3 |
| Partner Meeting | 1 table and 4 chairs | 4 seated people | 4, optional |
| Storage | Enclosed staff storage | 6 m² | Staff access |
| Exit | Departure to east aisle | 1500 mm clear opening | 5 |

## Exhibit records and exact panel copy
| ID | Panel title | Dimensions, mm | Zone | Panel body | Body word limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HB-01 | K1 demonstration unit | 600 × 650 × 1150 | Live Demo | A presenter starts a four-minute sequence: drive to the shelf, move one empty cup to the tray, and return to the charging dock. | 30 |
| HB-02 | K1 observation unit | 600 × 650 × 1150 | Observation | Explore the stationary K1 at close range: its wheeled base, sensor band and single right arm. | 30 |
| HB-03 | K1 charging dock | 700 × 450 × 180 | Live Demo | The charging dock marks the starting and finishing position of each live demonstration. | 30 |

## Demonstration record
- Start interval: 10 minutes
- Total sequence: 240 seconds
- Demonstration cup: 1 empty cup, 150 g
- Dock-to-shelf travel distance: 1500 mm
- Shelf and receiving tray: adjacent surfaces at 750 mm above floor
- Live sequence controller: brand presenter
- HB-02 state: stationary, right arm folded

| Step | Time span | Duration | Exact demonstration strip wording |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–30 seconds | 30 seconds | Presenter introduction |
| 2 | 30–90 seconds | 60 seconds | Drive 1500 mm to the shelf |
| 3 | 90–150 seconds | 60 seconds | Move one empty cup to the tray |
| 4 | 150–210 seconds | 60 seconds | Return to the charging dock |
| 5 | 210–240 seconds | 30 seconds | Presenter reset |

## Reusable frame kit
| Part | Quantity | Material | Dimensions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wall frame | 12 | Aluminium extrusion | 2500 × 1000 × 40 mm, length × width × thickness |
| Replaceable graphic skin | 12 | Tensioned polyester fabric | 2500 × 1000 mm |
| Stabilising foot | 24 | Steel | 500 × 300 × 10 mm, length × width × thickness |
| Frame-to-foot hand bolt | 48 | Steel with hand knob | M8 × 25 mm |
| Transport crate | 3 | Plywood with reusable latches | 2700 × 1100 × 700 mm external, length × width × height |

- Assembled frame height: 2500 mm
- Frame-to-frame connection: integral hand-operated cam locks
- Frame-to-foot connection: 2 hand bolts per foot
- Graphic attachment: silicone edges seated in frame channels
- Largest dismantled component: wall frame, 2500 × 1000 × 40 mm
- Crate allocation: 4 frames, 4 folded skins, 8 feet and 16 hand bolts per crate
- Furniture provision: locally rented meeting table, 4 chairs, storage fittings and pickup shelf

## Visitor context
- Typical visitor stay: 6–10 minutes
- Demonstration staffing: 1 presenter
- Partner meeting staffing: 1 channel representative
- Public information language: English
- Atmosphere reference: open exhibition session, mixed adult visitors, occasional family groups

# KINVA — delivery catalog

| 6 | observation-detail | Close observation detail | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | brand-display | Brand and display artwork | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | meeting-storage | Meeting and storage detail | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | entrance-view | South entrance visitor perspective | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

| 12 | dismantled-state | Dismantled packing state | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
KINVA | A working home robot demonstration booth

We are taking our K1 home service robot to a trade show and need a booth where visitors can watch a complete demonstration, inspect a second unit and sit down with our channel team. Our identity is fixed: print "KINVA" on the main fascia and product information panels, use primary colour #245C53, and print "See everyday assistance in action" on the fascia. Preserve the robot's warm grey body, dark sensor band, green chest insert and single right arm throughout the work.

The booth measures 10000 × 8000 mm, with a 3500 mm height limit, a closed north edge and 3000 mm aisles along its other three edges. The attached boundary drawing fixes the south entrance, east exit, western demonstration envelope and observation band. Provide 1500 mm clear visitor routes, an internal queue for four people, observation positions for six people including one wheelchair position, a four-seat meeting area and 6 m² of enclosed storage. Our three physical exhibits are HB-01, the working K1; HB-02, the stationary K1; and HB-03, its charging dock. Each robot measures 600 × 650 × 1150 mm; the dock measures 700 × 450 × 180 mm, all width × depth × height. Demonstrations run every 10 minutes: a 240-second sequence covers introduction, a 1500 mm drive to the shelf, transfer of one empty cup, return to the dock and reset. The booth's volume, furniture arrangement and graphic composition are open within these conditions.

Audience: trade show visitors learning how K1 is used, channel partners considering distribution, and demonstration staff preparing the live presentation.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the product records, demonstration timings, exact label copy, visitor capacities and reusable construction kit. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. booth-boundary.png fixes the site boundary, access openings, demonstration clearance and observation band. robot-and-dock.png records the existing robot and dock appearance. exhibition-aisle.png provides the atmosphere of visitors arriving during an open exhibition session.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page exhibit inventory and circulation specification covering HB-01–HB-03, their dimensions, six named zones, visitor order, capacities and mounting heights
2. A one-page label copy table containing three exhibit titles and bodies, the fascia wording and the five timed demonstration steps
3. One dimensioned master plan with exhibit IDs, all six zones, queue positions, entrance, exit and clear route widths
4. One coordinated elevation and section sheet with fascia, frame, observation rail, shelf and label heights
5. One demonstration detail sheet with the robot's operating envelope, 500 mm perimeter clearance, shelf, cup, dock and complete 240-second sequence
6. One close observation detail sheet with HB-02, six viewing positions including one wheelchair position, and product label placement
7. One brand and display artwork sheet containing the fascia, three exhibit panels and five-step demonstration strip
8. One meeting and storage detail sheet with four seats, a table and 6 m² of enclosed storage
9. Two visitor perspectives, one from the south entrance and one from the seated observation position
10. Two construction state sheets, one assembled and one dismantled, with the frame kit, connections and three transport crates
11. One 12-second booth walkthrough video linking entrance, queue, demonstration, close observation and meeting area
12. One presentation document of at least eight pages reusing the specifications, drawings, artwork and perspectives, with a fact-to-deliverable index

Acceptance:
- Establish the inventory and circulation specification and label copy table first; repeat HB-01–HB-03 and the six zone names on the master plan and presentation, and repeat the 750 mm shelf height and 1200 mm label centre height on the elevation and section sheet, relevant detail sheets and presentation.
- Dimension the master plan and demonstration detail sheet to the 10000 × 8000 mm boundary, 4500 × 4000 mm demonstration envelope and 500 mm perimeter clearance; mark 1500 mm clear visitor routes, four queue positions and six observation positions on the master plan, including the 900 × 1400 mm wheelchair position.
- Account for all 240 seconds on the label copy table and demonstration detail sheet using the five recorded steps; reproduce their timings and wording on the demonstration strip and in the presentation, with HB-01 and HB-03 in their recorded roles.
- Print KINVA and the exact fascia phrase on the brand and display artwork sheet, both visitor perspectives and presentation; reproduce all three exhibit titles and bodies from 01-client-facts.en.md on the artwork sheet and in the presentation, and carry #245C53 through these applications.
- Reconcile both visitor perspectives, the meeting and storage detail sheet and the 12-second walkthrough with the master plan's entrance, exit, four meeting seats and 6 m² storage; depict the robot and dock forms from robot-and-dock.png consistently in the demonstration detail, observation detail, perspectives and video.
- Account for 12 aluminium frames, 12 fabric skins, 24 feet and 48 hand bolts on both construction state sheets; identify hand-tightened connections, the 2500 × 1000 × 40 mm largest dismantled part and three 2700 × 1100 × 700 mm crates, and repeat this schedule in the presentation.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
